Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Welcome aboard—happy to walk you through it! Here’s a simple roadmap to get started:

Create your account & profile

Sign up on our site and tell us about your dog (age, weight, ideal weight, activity level, health goals).
We’ll use this to build a custom meal plan, including portion sizes.

Understand your trial & subscription

Your first shipment is a two-week trial of your dog’s personalized plan.
After that, orders auto-ship every four weeks so you don’t run out.
Through your online account, you can adjust:
Recipes and how much of each you get
Delivery dates and address
Payment details
You can change or cancel anytime, as long as it’s before the order deadline shown for your next box.

Check your portions & feeding guide

On your account’s Pets page, you’ll see:
Your dog’s selected recipes
Exact portion sizes and how much to feed per meal
You can also open the Feeding Guide there for up‑to‑date instructions, especially if you tweak your plan later.

Transition your dog safely

Don’t switch cold turkey—go slow over about a week:
Days 1–2: 25% Nom Nom + 75% current food
Days 3–4: 50% Nom Nom + 50% current food
Days 5–6: 75% Nom Nom + 25% current food
Day 7: 100% Nom Nom
If you’re just using Nom Nom as a topper, reduce their old food by roughly the same calories you add, so you’re not overfeeding.

When your first box arrives

Carefully open the box and lift the liner flap.
If you see dry ice, don’t touch it—leave it in a ventilated area until it disappears, away from kids and pets.
Once the dry ice is gone, move meals to the freezer, and put a couple in the fridge to serve soon.

If you ever pause and want to resume

Log into your account and choose “Pick a Plan.”
Update each pet’s plan, then on the review page confirm your plan, payment, and delivery address.
Click “Resume Subscription” to restart deliveries.

Curious about cost or wanting to sample first?

Price depends on your dog’s details (size, age, activity level, recipes, and your zip for tax).
If you’d rather taste-test first, you can grab a Variety Pack from Chewy or Amazon, or single packs from PetSmart, and then come back to set up your subscription when you’re ready.

You’re absolutely in the right place—start by creating your account and dog profile, and everything else (plan, portions, and deliveries) will flow from there.

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Here’s a quick rundown of your main options with us, in plain language:

Start a trial: Sign up, we build a custom meal plan, and you begin with a 2‑week trial, then it rolls into a recurring shipment every 4 weeks.
Customize meals: In your account’s Pets page, you can change:
Recipes your dog gets
Whether recipes stay fixed or rotate each order
Portion size (full or half, depending if you mix with other food)
How many meal packs per day you serve
Check feeding instructions: On the Pets page, you can open the Feeding Guide to see exactly how much to feed based on your dog’s needs.
Manage your subscription: In your account you can adjust:
What’s in each order
Delivery timing and address
Payment details and see past charges
Add or remove dogs:
Add a new pup by creating a profile and building a meal plan.
Removing a dog needs help from our team and will change your pricing.
Add extras: On the Extras page you can add treats and probiotics, either as a one‑time add-on or in every box.
Choose activity level: When setting up your dog’s profile, choose Average, Active, or Athlete so we portion meals correctly.
Try us without a subscription: You can buy Variety Packs or single packs of our recipes from Chewy, Amazon, or PetSmart, so your dog can taste-test before starting a subscription.
Shop retail instead of subscribing: All 6 recipes plus select treats/probiotics are available online (and some in-store) through PetSmart, Amazon, and Chewy.

So big picture: you can try us via a trial or retail packs, fully customize what and how much your dog eats, add extras, and manage everything from your online account.
